name: covenant-wedding-planner
description: The Covenant Wedding Planner — a static, offline-capable client-side planning app. Dev tooling for serving the app and running consistency/visual checks.

scripts.check: for f in tools/check-duplicate-functions.js tools/check-main-panels.js tools/check-panel-display-css.js tools/check-panel-nesting.js tools/check-panel-nesting2.js; do echo "=== $f ==="; node "$f" || exit 1; done
